Data controller

The data controller under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) is SANİTEKS SÜNGER SANAYİ TURİZM VE TİCARET ANONİM ŞİRKETİ. You can reach our company by e-mail at info@saniteks.com.tr, by phone on 0 850 304 01 10 or at the address 15 Temmuz Mah. Bahar Cad. Polat İş Merkezi C Blok 6/2 Zemin No:1 Güneşli - Bağcılar / İSTANBUL.

Personal data processed

When you use the contact form, your first and last name, e-mail address, the subject you select and your message are processed. Sharing your phone number is optional.

Purposes of processing personal data

  • Receiving, assessing and responding to your contact request.
  • Carrying out communication related to your request.
  • Ensuring the security of the contact form and limiting misuse.

Method of collecting personal data

Your personal data are obtained electronically when you enter your details in the contact form on the website yourself and submit the form. The form content is forwarded to the company mailbox over a TLS-protected SMTP connection and is not stored in the website database.

Processing conditions and legal grounds

Depending on the nature of the contact request, personal data may be processed on the grounds that processing is directly related to the conclusion or performance of a contract, or that it is necessary for the legitimate interests of the data controller. The applicable ground is assessed according to the subject of the request and the relationship sought.

Transfer of personal data

Your contact details and message may be shared with authorised persons within the company in order to respond to your request, and with the e-mail infrastructure service provider to the extent necessary to provide the e-mail delivery service. Where there is a legal obligation, they may be transferred to legally authorised public authorities and bodies.

Retention and deletion

Information sent via the contact form is kept in the company mailbox for as long as needed to resolve the request. Unless another legal obligation requires retention, it is deleted when the need for retention ends.

Rights of the data subject

Under Article 11 of KVKK (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698), you may apply to our company to:

  • learn whether your personal data are being processed,
  • request information about it if it has been processed,
  • learn the purpose of processing and whether the data are used in line with that purpose,
  • know the third parties to whom the data are transferred in Türkiye or abroad,
  • request the correction of incomplete or inaccurately processed data,
  • request erasure or destruction under the conditions set out in the Law,
  • request that the third parties to whom the data have been transferred be notified of any correction, erasure or destruction,
  • object to an outcome to your detriment arising from analysis by automated systems,
  • request compensation if you suffer damage as a result of unlawful processing

Method of application

You can submit requests concerning your rights in writing to our company's postal address given above, together with information identifying you and explaining your request, or by other methods permitted by the legislation.

Changes to this notice

This privacy notice may be updated in line with changes in personal data processing activities or in the relevant legislation. The current version and the date of the last update are shown at the top of the page.
